item.thaumaenergistics.upgrade_arcane.to: Recharges the wand stored in the arcane crafting terminal with vis from the local aura
research.thaumaenergistics.arcane_chargi: My wand sits idle inside the terminal while I work. The charger I built for my Arcane Workbench draws vis from the surrounding aura; if I bind its workings into an advanced upgrade card, the terminal might top up the wand by itself.
I can now make an Arcane Charging Upgrade. Installed in an Arcane Crafting Terminal, it recharges the wand stored inside with vis from the aura around the terminal.
research.thaumaenergistics.arcane_termin: Maybe I can combine a ME Terminal with an Arcane Workbench to get something that will help me with my arcane endeavours.
I can now make an Arcane Crafting Terminal.
research.thaumaenergistics.base_energist:
As both a scientist and an arcane scholar, I have postulated that it must be possible to combine technology and magic in a stable and productive way.
I should study the principles of matter-energy conversion in detail to accomplish this. It is likely there are aspects of Thaumaturgy that can accomplish this, as well as technology capable of doing the same.
This will require extensive study, but I am sure that it will be a worthwhile investment of my time.
First I must examine some of this strange networked technology with my Thaumometer.
research.thaumaenergistics.digisentia.st:
Having discovered how to distill essentia, it occurs to me that I may be able to store it digitally.
Examining the Formation Core and Annihilation Core I realize that with some minor modifications they could serve as a means to convert essentia to and from a digital format.
However, due to the corrosive nature of certain types of essentia, a layer of quicksilver around the circuitry is required to prevent decay.

Diffusion Core
The relatively high volatility and immense energy in distilled essentia requires that it first be diffused then digitized. A buffer chamber of some kind will likely be required to hold the diffused essentia.Coalescence Core
Compresses and binds re-materialized essentia diffusion back into its raw form. A buffer chamber will also likely be needed.
research.thaumaenergistics.essentia_expo: The reverse should also be possible: a bus that pushes essentia from the network into whatever needs it.
I can now make an Essentia Export Bus.
research.thaumaenergistics.essentia_impo: Essentia sits in jars and conduits. A bus that pulls it into the network would save me a lot of carrying.
I can now make an Essentia Import Bus.
research.thaumaenergistics.essentia_stor: Like I did with my previous attempt to get bigger storage components, I can use some high end processors to combine multiple storage components together.
Using another type of processor, I can now store 16 times the amount of essentia on a storage component than when I started with my crude storage system.

Upon inspecting existing digital storage mediums I have concluded that I can in fact store digitized essentia.
By infusing Certus Quartz with Salis Mundus, it should gain the ability to store the essentia, which remains remarkably active even in digital form.
I theorize that the higher the concentration of Salis Mundus, the more it should be able to store, although there are inherent limits as to how much the quartz itself can store.
I have managed to create a storage device capable of storing a small amount of essentia digitally. Maybe I could combine multiple components for increased storage?
Even the largest storage component I have built will not last forever. If I stack enough of the refined processors, perhaps I can reach one more step.
A single component now holds a colossal amount of essentia. This must surely be the ceiling of what this technology can do.
Maybe I can use some different processing components to combine multiple storage components together.
I can now store a decent amount of essentia digitally by using some calculation processors to allow the components to talk to each other.
My current storage needs are not enough. I hope I can still combine storage components to create a larger one while taking up the same space...
I can now store massive amounts of essentia on a storage component, but I feel that this is the limit of the technology.
Instead of moving essentia around, I could present a whole jar to the network as if it were part of it.
I can now make an Essentia Storage Bus.
research.thaumaenergistics.essentia_term: With the essentia stored digitally, I need a way to look at it. A terminal made for essentia alone should let me see and pull every aspect in my network.
I can now make an Essentia Terminal.
research.thaumaenergistics.f_ae_core.tit: Examine something related to Applied Energistics.
research.thaumaenergistics.infinity_cell: The colossal storage is still a finite vessel, and sooner or later it will fill. Whispers speak of Terminus, an aspect of the end of all bounds, that unmakes limits themselves. If I infuse a colossal cell with it, flanked by diffusion cores and the finest components, perhaps the cell will stop counting at all.
I can now make an Infinity Essentia Storage Cell. It holds essentia without a ceiling, and the Terminus woven into it makes the infusion dangerously unstable.
research.thaumaenergistics.infusion_prov: Now that I can digitize essentia, it's time to put that technology to work. Perhaps an infusion matrix could draw the essentia it needs straight from my network.
I can now make an Infusion Provider. Placed within reach of an infusion matrix and connected to my network, it hands over the essentia an infusion asks for.
research.thaumaenergistics.wireless_arca: Being tied to a block is a nuisance when my work takes me far from the lab. If I fit a wireless receiver and a dense energy cell to my Arcane Crafting Terminal, I should be able to carry it with me.
I can now make a Wireless Arcane Crafting Terminal. Linked to a wireless access point it reaches my network from afar, and it draws on the vis around me instead of a fixed place.
research.thaumaenergistics.wireless_esse: Checking my essentia stores means walking back to the lab every time. If I fit a wireless receiver and a dense energy cell to my Essentia Terminal, I should be able to read my network from anywhere.
I can now make a Wireless Essentia Terminal. Linked to a wireless access point it shows and hands over the essentia in my network from afar.
